RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the December 16, 2008/Agrahayana 25, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Prime Minister; Ministries : Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture;
Finance; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 155
363
Setting up of captive airports
1550. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to set up
captive airports and heliports across the
country for private use;
(b) if so, the details thereof, indicating
the objective behind this project;
(c) whether some of such helipads are
proposed to be set up in Orissa, Jharkhand
etc.; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Flights from Gulf to Kerala
1551. PROF. P.J. KURIEN: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has received
representation to increase the passenger
flights from Gulf region to Kerala, during
the festival season, and to do away with
the practice of hiking the airfare during such
seasons;
(b) whether Government is aware that
such high fares are unaffordable to Indian
workers in Gulf who are mostly skilled
and semi-skilled workers;
(c) if so, whether Government would
consider to stop the practice of hiking high
fare during festival seasons; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Shortage of pilots
1552. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIA TION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is an acute shortage
of pilots for the Aircrafts in India and
Airways in India both private and public
depend upon pilots from abroad to manage
the shortage;
(b) if so, the number of pilots with their
category drawn from aboard and working
in Indian Airways and their period of tenure
there, airways-wise;
(c) whether there are short-term and
long-term plans to get over this shortage
and the future requirement; and
(d) whether there has been a detailed
study relating to the volume of air traffic
over a period of time in future and the

364
corresponding infrastructure, aircrafts,
man-power required to meet the challenge?
Dues of Kingfisher and Jet Airways
1553. SHRI PRAVEEN RASHTRA-
PAL: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) the dues from Jet Airways and
Kingfisher to Government for use of Airport
Authority of India runways and other
infrastructure facilities as on 31st March,
2008;
(b) in what manner this facility was
allowed  to these two particular airways
and what are the terms and conditions for
delay in payment by the above airways;
(c) whether Kingfisher is given special
treatment alongwith Air India, as far as using
the Terminal-A at New Delhi Airport, is
concerned;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor;
(e) whether such facilities are not given
to other private airways;
(f) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(g) the criteria of charges from number
of private airways for use of Terminal-A or
B or some time use of International Airport
for domestic flights?
Airport at Shirdi
†1554. SHRI MANOHAR JOSHI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is long
time demand of devotees going to visit Sai
Baba in Shirdi that an airport be constructed
in Shirdi with air connectivity to all major
cities of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has any plan
to setup the airport at Shirdi;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Helipads for Commonwealth Games
1555. SHRI TARIQ ANW AR: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has decided to have helipads in each of the
nine districts of Delhi for the upcoming
Commonwealth Games; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Rules for cabin crew
1556. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIA TION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that individual
airlines are now implementing the rules
pertaining to Cabin Crew flight time limits,
etc. as per the labour laws;
(b) if so, whether it is true that the
Directorate General of Civil Aviation
(DGCA) has prepared a draft Civil Aviation
Requirement Proposal for Cabin Crew in
the country; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?

JAV ADEKAR:
SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  A VIATION
be pleased to state:
